title: Biology
description: ISC Class XI Biology: one theory paper of 3 hours carrying 70 marks plus 10 marks practical-file weightage and 20 marks practical examination.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Biology (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Biological Classification; Plant Kingdom; Animal Kingdom; Morphology of Flowering Plants; Anatomy of Flowering Plants; Structural Organisation in Animals; Cell Unit of Life; Biomolecules; Cell Cycle and Cell Division; Transport in Plants; Mineral Nutrition; Photosynthesis; Respiration in Plants; Plant Growth and Development.

sections.title: Biology
sections.description: Diversity, structural organisation, cell biology and plant physiology.

chapters.title: Biological Classification
chapters.blurb: Taxonomy, nomenclature, species, genus and family; five-kingdom classification; viruses, viroids, lichens.

chapters.title: Plant Kingdom
chapters.blurb: Algae, bryophytes, pteridophytes, gymnosperms and angiosperms; life cycles and alternation of generations.

chapters.title: Animal Kingdom
chapters.blurb: Basis of classification, non-chordates from Porifera to Chordata, classes of vertebrates.

chapters.title: Morphology of Flowering Plants
chapters.blurb: Root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit, seed; modifications, semi-technical floral formula and floral diagram.

chapters.title: Anatomy of Flowering Plants
chapters.blurb: Tissues, tissue systems, anatomy of root, stem and leaf, secondary growth, dicot vs monocot.

chapters.title: Structural Organisation in Animals
chapters.blurb: Animal tissues (epithelial, connective, muscular, neural), cockroach anatomy as a representative.

chapters.title: Cell: The Unit of Life
chapters.blurb: Cell theory, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, cell organelles, membrane transport.

chapters.title: Biomolecules
chapters.blurb: Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, enzymes and their structures.

chapters.title: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
chapters.blurb: Phases of cell cycle, mitosis, meiosis, significance.

chapters.title: Transport in Plants
chapters.blurb: Diffusion, osmosis, water potential, ascent of sap, phloem translocation, transpiration.

chapters.title: Mineral Nutrition
chapters.blurb: Essential elements, deficiency symptoms, nitrogen fixation, hydroponics.

chapters.title: Photosynthesis
chapters.blurb: Light reaction, dark reaction (Calvin cycle), C3 and C4 pathways, limiting factors.

chapters.title: Respiration in Plants
chapters.blurb: Glycolysis, fermentation, aerobic respiration, respiratory quotient.

chapters.title: Plant Growth and Development
chapters.blurb: Phases and rates of growth, differentiation, plant growth regulators, photoperiodism, vernalisation.
